content:
#9 fix: add the synonyms for Commuting Triangle (Commutative Triangle and Abelian Triangle in QFT) and respective hyperlinks in parenthesis right after “commuting triangles”. Syntactical redundancy will help to reduce ambiguity in the understanding, as well as to unify the jargon around “commutative”.

In the case of Abelian Triangle, this is used in “Abelian Triangle Anomaly” in Quantum Field Theory and related to Chiral Magnetic Effect (CME), as in V.I.Shevchenko’s 2013 paper “Non-Stationary Measurements of Chiral Magnetic Effect”, which seems to quickly be generalized to “Abelian Anomaly”, removing the word triangle from the rest of the text and keeping it only at the Abstract.
